authoritative: The German version is authoritative.
p_sub: for the app “Suya: Audio Sleep Tracker” and this website · Last updated: 12 November 2026.
short: Suya analyses your sleep on your iPhone. Recordings, results and health data never leave your device – unless you share them yourself or explicitly opt in to donating nights. There are no accounts, no ads, no tracking and no third-party analytics.
dpo: There is no data protection officer, as none is required. For any privacy question, write to the address above.
mic_p: During a night recording, Suya records sounds through the microphone (breathing, snoring, movement, surroundings). On the device it derives sleep stages, sound events and a sleep score. Recordings are stored only on your iPhone. You can delete them at any time – one by one, all at once, or keeping only the short clips of detected sounds. 24 hours after a night ends, Suya deletes the audio automatically (until then you can export the night in full, including audio). Only the short clips of detected sounds remain, plus a coarse sound picture (spectrogram, no audio) for 7 days.
motion_p: When the iPhone lies in bed, Suya measures coarse movement with the accelerometer. These values also stay on the device.
health_p: If you allow it, Suya reads your Apple Watch sleep stages as well as heart rate, heart rate variability, respiratory rate and blood oxygen from Apple Health to compare them with its own estimate. Suya also writes its estimated sleep stages (In Bed, Awake, Core, Deep, REM) to Health, marked as entries from Suya. If your Apple Watch recorded the same night, its data takes precedence and Suya removes its own entries for that night. Health data is never used for advertising or marketing and never shared with third parties. You can change permissions at any time in the Health app.
alarm_p: Alarms (via Apple’s AlarmKit), the lock-screen display and the sleep sounds run entirely on the device. The sleep sounds ship with the app.
share_p: With “Share” you can export a night as a file, optionally including audio. You decide where it goes via the iOS share sheet; Suya does not send anything to us.
device_basis: for on-device processing is providing the features you use (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and, for health data, your consent through the iOS permission prompts (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR). As this data does not leave your device, we have no access to it.
don_p: Suya can only improve its sleep stage detection with real nights. You can therefore donate nights – voluntarily, revocable at any time. Nothing is sent without your explicit consent in the app. Suya works exactly the same without donating. Donating requires you to be 18 or older.
what_1: A coarse sound picture of the night (spectrogram with 64 frequency bands, 10 times per second) and the loudness per second. It reveals breathing, snoring and movement, but speech cannot be understood and no recording can be restored. No audio is sent.
what_2: Your Apple Watch sleep stages for the same period and when Suya’s sleep sounds were playing – without date or time of day, only counted from the start of the recording.
what_3: iPhone model, app version and a random donor number with its key. No name, no Apple ID, no device identifier, no location.
which_p: Only nights recorded after your consent, with at least 5 hours of recording and Apple Watch sleep stages, are donated automatically. You can donate older nights one by one by pressing and holding them in the app – as long as their sound picture is still on the iPhone (7 days).
purpose_p: Solely to train and evaluate the model Suya uses to estimate sleep stages. No advertising, no sale, no sharing, no profiles of individuals.
basis_p: Your explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a) and Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR). The time and version of the consent text are stored on your device.
where_p1: Donated nights are sent encrypted (HTTPS) and only over Wi-Fi to the controller’s own server (network storage) in Hamburg, Germany, and stored there. There are no processors, no cloud services and no transfers to third countries.
where_p2: Donated nights are deleted automatically 6 months after receipt, and immediately upon withdrawal or a deletion request. An already trained model contains only learned weights from which individual nights cannot be restored; it is not withdrawn upon deletion, but later training no longer uses deleted nights. A log records only when a night was received or deleted for which donor number.
attest_p: So that only the genuine Suya app can donate, the app uses Apple’s “App Attest” service: your iPhone has Apple confirm that the request comes from an unmodified Suya app. Apple receives none of the content of your donation.
withdraw_p: Under “More” in the app you can withdraw your donation at any time and have all donated nights deleted with “Request deletion of my data”. Alternatively, email your donor number to the address above. Withdrawal applies to the future and does not affect processing carried out before (Art. 7(3) GDPR).
web_p: This website sets no cookies, embeds no third-party content (fonts, maps, videos) and uses no tracking. Visits are not logged. Your IP address is necessarily processed to deliver the page and, for rate limiting of the donation interface, kept in memory for at most one hour, never stored (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; legitimate interest in secure operation). Only on technical errors may the server’s web server write an error message including an IP address. These error logs are used solely for troubleshooting and are rotated and overwritten automatically by the server’s operating system.
rights_p1: You have the right of access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and objection (Art. 21), and the right to withdraw consent at any time (Art. 7(3)). Because we store no names, requests about donated nights need your donor number.
rights_p2: You may also lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, for example the one responsible for us: Der Hamburgische Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit, Ludwig-Erhard-Straße 22, 20459 Hamburg, Germany.
medical_p: Suya estimates sleep stages from sounds. Results are not a medical measurement and do not replace a medical examination.
changes_p: If what Suya does with data changes, we update this policy. If the content of the data donation changes, the app asks for your consent again.
i_sub: Information according to § 5 of the German Digital Services Act (DDG)
i_resp_p: according to § 18(2) of the German Interstate Media Treaty (MStV): Niklas Groß, address as above.
i_note_1: Suya is a privately developed project. The app estimates sleep stages from sounds and is not a medical device.
i_note_2: The app’s sleep sounds come from freely licensed sources; authors and licences are listed in the app under “More” → “Sound credits”.
x_p: Suya lies next to you at night and listens: from breathing, movement and sounds it estimates your sleep stages, wakes you gently in light sleep and adds your night to Apple Health – no watch on your wrist needed.
x_card_b: Your nights stay on your iPhone.
x_card: No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Only if you explicitly choose to, you donate a coarse sound picture of your nights – without audio – to make Suya more accurate for everyone.
x_muted: Suya is not a medical device.
bug_p: Under “More” → “Report a problem” you can describe a bug to us. Only what you enter is sent (your description and, optionally, contact details for follow-up questions), plus technical details that you see before sending and can switch off: app version, iOS version, iPhone model, language and the status of permissions and data donation. If available, this includes the crash logs of the last 30 days that iOS provides to the app (program flow at the time of the crash, device and iOS version). Also the app's error messages from its current run (e.g. “alarm could not be set”), without any content of your nights. No recordings, no sleep data, no IP address. The report is transmitted encrypted (HTTPS) to the same private server in Hamburg, used only to fix bugs and deleted after twelve months at the latest, or immediately on request (contact see above). The legal basis is your consent by sending it (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).
